name: Video embed
description: A 16:9 video behind a poster and a real play button. The provider's player loads only when the visitor activates play, never on page load. Comes with a caption, a transcript link and a privacy note.

fields.name: Heading
fields.helpText: Rendered as the h2. Empty falls back to a visually hidden h2 using the video title.

fields.name: Video URL
fields.helpText: YouTube (loaded from youtube-nocookie.com), Vimeo, or an MP4 from the media library.

fields.name: Video title
fields.helpText: Used in the play button's name and as the player title.

fields.name: Duration
fields.helpText: For example "2:14". Shown in the chip and spoken aloud in the play button's name.

fields.name: Poster
fields.helpText: 16:9, honours the focal point. Falls back to a plain fill when empty.

fields.name: Transcript link label
fields.helpText: Hidden together with the link when either is empty.

fields.name: Transcript link
fields.helpText: A page or PDF. Strongly recommended when the video has speech.

fields.name: Privacy note
fields.helpText: Name the actual provider. Defaults to "Loads from YouTube when you press play" when unset.
